easybank.description: Scalable fintech platform for managing services, offers, users, and onboarding with AI-powered loan assessment.

The platform features AI-powered loan eligibility assessment, seamless client experience from application to approval, and integrated financial consulting services.

notecontrol.title: Note-Control - Smart Hybrid Notebook
notecontrol.description: Smart notebook system merging analog comfort with digital power for revolutionary note-taking experience.
notecontrol.longDescription: Note-Control bridges traditional writing and digital organization with real-time handwriting recognition, multi-device sync, and collaborative features. The system offers QR-based fast activation, AI-powered handwriting to text conversion, smart task management, and cross-device synchronization. Reduces paper usage by 70% and organization time by 50%.

Features metaverse environments, customizable virtual offices, session scheduling, speaker management, and recruitment tools with applicant tracking. Used in national-level events and designed to scale with modern business needs.
